title: Hit points follow damage until overridden
description: hp is a formula over max_hp and damage_taken. A hand override freezes it and marks it; clearing the override makes it follow its inputs again. Undo reverses the clear. The damage amounts (5, then 10) and the override value (30) are chosen by this transcription; the prose fixes only max_hp 27 and damage_taken 0.

expect.note: "max_hp: 27", "damage_taken: 0", "hp = max_hp - damage_taken": 27 - 0 = 27.
"hp = max_hp - damage_taken" is a formula; FIXTURES §6: an override is how one would "Type a literal over a formula cell", and none has been typed.
FIXTURES §8: "Every step that is neither rejected nor `bind` appends exactly one group"; no step has run.

steps.note: Aldric takes 5 damage (amount chosen by the transcription).

expect.note: "A `set` on `damage_taken` moves `hp`" (FIXTURES §9); "hp = max_hp - damage_taken": 27 - 5 = 22.
"A `set` on `damage_taken` moves `hp`" (FIXTURES §9): hp still follows its formula, so no marker.
FIXTURES §8: "An `invoke` is one group for the whole action; `set`, `override`, `clear_override`, `move`, and `spawn` are one group each".
FIXTURES §7: "A `write` matches a resolved cell write in the group: the value written".

steps.note: The GM types 30 over the hp formula (value chosen by the transcription).

expect.note: "Overriding `hp` by hand freezes it until the override is cleared; the inspector marks it." The override's value replaces the formula's 22.
"the inspector marks it"; "the `override` expectation shows the inspector's marker" (FIXTURES §9).
FIXTURES §8: "An `invoke` is one group for the whole action; `set`, `override`, `clear_override`, `move`, and `spawn` are one group each".
FIXTURES §7: the write matched is "for `override`, the overriding value".

steps.note: Further damage does not show while hp is overridden.

expect.note: "a further `set` on `damage_taken` is asserted *not* to change `hp`" (FIXTURES §9); DESIGN §4.2: "Overriding `hp` means later damage will not show until the override is cleared".
"Overriding `hp` by hand freezes it until the override is cleared; the inspector marks it." Not yet cleared, so still marked.
FIXTURES §6: `set` is "Hand-edit a literal"; the input itself changes, only hp is frozen.

steps.note: Clearing the override makes hp follow its inputs again.

expect.note: "`clear_override` restores tracking" (FIXTURES §9); "hp = max_hp - damage_taken" = 27 - 10 = 17.
"freezes it until the override is cleared; the inspector marks it": cleared, so no marker.

steps.note: Undo reverses the clear; the override and its marker come back.

expect.note: "An `undo` of the clear brings the override back" (FIXTURES §9): hp is the override's 30 again.
"An `undo` of the clear brings the override back" (FIXTURES §9), and "the inspector marks it".
FIXTURES §8: "`undo` reverses the most recent group that is neither an undo nor already undone": that is the clear, so the set to 10 stands.
FIXTURES §8: set, override, set, clear_override, undo; "`undo` is one group, because undo is itself an operation", and "It does not delete that group".
